label: Find readers who want to buy your book in social media comments with an AI agent
description: Every evening, finds people who asked when the book comes out or said they would buy it, and saves them to a data table with the story they commented on.

parameters.systemPrompt: From the comments, keep only people who ask when or where the book is available, ask for a copy, or say they will buy it. Ignore compliments without buying intent. Before saving a person, use findRecords to check they are not already in the table, then save each new person with createRecords.

records.name: =fromAi('name', 'STRING', {'required': true})
records.story: =fromAi('story', 'STRING', {'description': 'Title of the story they commented on', 'required': true})

stickyNotes.content:
## Setup

This template has not been run end to end yet. Before you run it:

1. Anthropic API key.
2. Google Sheets connection.
3. A spreadsheet with new comments; replace REPLACE_WITH_SOCIAL_EXPORT_SPREADSHEET_ID.
4. A ByteChef data table for interested readers; replace REPLACE_WITH_INTERESTED_READERS_TABLE.

Comments come from a spreadsheet export. Once those PRs merge, the agent can read comments directly with the LinkedIn, Facebook Pages and Instagram Get Comments actions.
